## Hiring FAQ

### Can you build both the Android and iOS app for my business?

Yes. I build cross-platform apps with Flutter, so one codebase ships to both Android and iOS, and I handle the Play Store and App Store submission too.

### Do you also build the backend and database?

Yes. I design the database and build the backend APIs with Laravel, FastAPI, Node.js or Serverpod, add an API gateway such as Kong, integrate payments like Razorpay, and deploy it on AWS, Hostinger or cPanel servers.

### Do you build websites and web apps too?

Yes. I build responsive websites, e-commerce stores, web apps and admin dashboards with Laravel, PHP, Next.js, Node.js and Python, connected to the same backend as your mobile app.

### Can you add AI features like chatbots or smart search?

Yes. I integrate LLMs and vector databases to build AI assistants, semantic search and document Q&A, using hosted or local models.

### Do you work with international clients?

Yes. I work remotely with startups, agencies and businesses in India and internationally, including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, the UK and the USA, on fixed-price or hourly freelance contracts.

## How projects work

1. **Discovery call**: We talk through your goals, users and must-haves. You get honest advice, including when something isn't worth building.
2. **Scope & estimate**: A written scope with milestones and a fixed quote or clear hourly estimate, so there are no surprises.
3. **Build in milestones**: Regular demos and test builds you can try, with feedback built into each milestone.
4. **Test, deploy & launch**: Testing, deployment to your servers or stores, and a launch checklist.
5. **Support & growth**: Fixes, updates and new features after launch, whenever you need them.

### FAQ

**What's the difference between a website and a web application?**
A website mainly presents information. A web application lets users log in and do things: manage orders, track inventory, book slots or view reports. It needs a backend, a database and user permissions.

**Can the same backend power a mobile app too?**
Yes. I design the API so a Flutter mobile app can use the same backend and database as the web app.

**Do you build SaaS products?**
Yes. I build multi-user applications with roles, subscriptions and payment integration. We usually start with a focused first version and grow it from real user feedback.

**Who owns the code?**
You do. After payment you get the full source code, database and deployment access.

## Flutter development

URL: https://www.ansariatif.tech/flutter-development

Flutter is my main tool for mobile apps. My healthcare, food-ordering, inventory and game apps are all built with Flutter and Dart. When you hire me you get a Flutter developer who also understands the other side of the app: APIs, databases, payments and deployment.

That matters, because most app problems in production aren't in the UI. They're in the connection between the app and the backend.

### Flutter work I take on

- **Existing app takeover**: Code review, refactoring, dependency upgrades and bug fixes.
- **Performance & architecture**: Clean state management, modular code and faster builds.

### FAQ

**Why Flutter instead of separate native apps?**
One codebase for Android and iOS means lower cost, faster releases and one set of bugs to fix. For most business apps the performance is indistinguishable from native.

**Can you work with my existing Flutter code?**
Yes. I'll review the code, flag risks and continue development, or refactor the parts that are slowing you down.

**What is Serverpod?**
Serverpod is a backend framework written in Dart. It lets the app and server share models and code, which is a good fit for Flutter-first teams. For a hands-on example, see my Serverpod and Flutter tutorial with BLoC and clean architecture. I also build backends with Laravel, FastAPI and Node.js.

**Can I hire you part-time or for a fixed scope?**
Both work. Fixed scope suits a defined app or feature. Ongoing monthly support suits continuous development.

**Can you build just the API for my existing app?**

**Can you improve a slow backend?**
Yes. I profile slow endpoints and queries, add indexes and caching, and fix the root causes.

## API integration

URL: https://www.ansariatif.tech/api-integration

Most businesses run on several tools that don't talk to each other. I connect them through APIs so data moves automatically: orders into your accounting tool, leads into your CRM, updates to customers on WhatsApp, and payments confirmed by webhook instead of by hand.

Good integrations aren't just 'call the API'. They handle retries, timeouts, duplicate events and logging, so nothing silently breaks at 2 a.m.

### Integrations I build

- **Third-party API integration**: Connect your app or website to external services and SaaS tools.
- **WhatsApp API integration**: Order updates, notifications and customer messages through WhatsApp APIs.
- **Payment integrations**: Razorpay payments, refunds and subscriptions with webhook verification.
- **Webhooks & event flows**: React to events from other systems in real time.
- **Internal system sync**: Keep CRM, ERP, inventory and databases in sync.
- **API gateway setup**: Secure and monitor your APIs with Kong.

### What's included

- Integration design and data mapping
- Secure credential handling
- Retries, idempotency and error handling
- Logging and alerting
- Testing against sandbox environments
- Documentation for your team

### Technologies

REST APIs, Webhooks, Razorpay, WhatsApp APIs, Kong, Laravel, FastAPI, Node.js, Python

### What affects the cost

- Number of systems to connect
- Quality of each provider's API and documentation
- One-way vs two-way sync
- Volume and real-time requirements
- Monitoring and support needs

### Relevant work

- OneFoodDialer | Food-tech platform | Mobile · web backend | role: App, backend, payments, API gateway | stack: Flutter · Laravel · Razorpay · Kong | publisher: Futurescape Technologies Pvt Ltd | https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.onefooddialer

### FAQ

**Can you integrate WhatsApp with my website or app?**
Yes. I can send order updates, alerts and notifications through WhatsApp APIs, or connect incoming messages to your system.

**What if the third-party API is poorly documented?**
I test against their sandbox, log real responses and build defensive handling around edge cases. I'll also tell you early if an integration is risky.

**Can you connect my app to my CRM or ERP?**
If the system has an API (most do), yes. I map your data, build the sync and add monitoring.

## Payment gateway integration

URL: https://www.ansariatif.tech/payment-gateway-integration

Payments have to be correct every time. I integrate payment gateways into websites, web apps and Flutter mobile apps, including the server-side part many integrations get wrong: verifying payments with signatures and webhooks before an order is marked as paid.

I've integrated Razorpay in a production food-ordering platform, from app checkout to backend order updates.

### Payment work I do

- **Razorpay checkout**: UPI, cards, net banking and wallets in your website or app.
- **Server-side verification**: Signature and webhook verification, so orders can't be faked.
- **Subscriptions & recurring billing**: Plans, renewals and failed-payment handling for SaaS and memberships.
- **Refunds & reconciliation**: Refund flows and matching payments to orders in your admin panel.
- **Flutter in-app payments**: Native payment flow in Android and iOS apps.
- **Fixing broken integrations**: Missing webhooks, duplicate orders and payment-status mismatches.

### What's included

- Checkout on web and/or app
- Backend order and payment records
- Webhook handling and signature checks
- Refunds and status updates
- Test mode → live mode go-live checklist
- Documentation for your team

### Technologies

Razorpay, Webhooks, Laravel, PHP, FastAPI, Node.js, Flutter, MySQL, PostgreSQL

### What affects the cost

- One-time payments vs subscriptions
- Web, app, or both
- Existing backend or new
- Refund and reconciliation needs
- Number of payment flows (orders, wallets, payouts)

### Relevant work

- OneFoodDialer | Food-tech platform | Mobile · web backend | role: App, backend, payments, API gateway | stack: Flutter · Laravel · Razorpay · Kong | publisher: Futurescape Technologies Pvt Ltd | https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.onefooddialer

### FAQ

**Do you integrate Razorpay in Flutter apps?**
Yes. I integrate Razorpay checkout in Flutter apps and verify every payment on the backend before confirming the order.

**Why do I need webhooks if checkout already works?**
Because users close apps, networks drop and callbacks fail. Webhooks let your server confirm the payment independently, which prevents unpaid orders and missing ones.

**Can you fix my existing payment integration?**
Yes. I'll audit the flow, fix verification and status handling, and add logging so issues are traceable.

URL: https://www.ansariatif.tech/ai-development

AI is useful when it's connected to your data and your workflow, not as a demo. I integrate large language models into existing websites, apps and internal tools: assistants that answer from your documents, search that understands meaning, and automations that read, classify and draft for your team.

### FAQ

**Can you add AI to my existing app?**
Yes. I usually add AI as a backend service (for example with FastAPI) that your current web or mobile app calls, so your app doesn't need a rewrite.

**Will my data be private?**
We choose the setup based on your data. Hosted APIs with appropriate settings, or local models running on your own server when data must not leave it.

**How do you make sure the AI gives correct answers?**
By grounding answers in your own documents (retrieval), adding guardrails, and testing on real questions from your business before launch. AI can still make mistakes, so we design the workflow with a human check where it matters.

## Business automation

URL: https://www.ansariatif.tech/business-automation

If someone on your team copies data between tools, downloads the same report every morning or checks websites by hand, that work can usually be automated. I build reliable automations with Python, Playwright and APIs that run on a schedule, alert you when something changes and log everything they do.

Where it helps, I add AI to read, classify or summarise. Where it doesn't, a simple script is often the better answer.

### What I automate

- **Repetitive data entry**: Move data between spreadsheets, CRMs, portals and databases.
- **Browser automation**: Playwright bots for portals that have no API.
- **Scheduled reports**: Daily or weekly reports generated and sent automatically.
- **Workflow automation**: Approvals, notifications and hand-offs between tools and people.
- **Automated testing**: End-to-end tests that catch broken releases before users do.
- **Monitoring & alerts**: Get notified on WhatsApp or email when something needs attention.

### What's included

- Process mapping with your team
- Automation scripts or services
- Scheduling and retries
- Logs and failure alerts
- Documentation and handover
- Optional hosting and monitoring

### Technologies

Python, Playwright, REST APIs, Webhooks, FastAPI, Node.js, Docker, AWS, AI APIs

### What affects the cost

- Number of steps and systems involved
- API available vs browser automation needed
- Run frequency and data volume
- Error handling and alerting needs
- Hosting and ongoing maintenance

### Relevant work



### FAQ

**What kinds of tasks can be automated?**
Anything repetitive and rule-based: data entry, report generation, moving data between tools, checking portals, sending reminders and testing websites.

**What if the website or portal has no API?**
I use Playwright to automate the browser the way a person would, with safeguards for slow pages and layout changes.

**Where do the automations run?**
On a small cloud server, your own server, or scheduled on existing infrastructure. I set up logging and alerts either way.

## DevOps & server management

URL: https://www.ansariatif.tech/devops-server-management

Code only helps your business when it's running reliably. I deploy and manage websites, backend APIs and databases on AWS, with S3 storage and Docker, or on Hostinger (hPanel) and cPanel hosting, with domains, SSL, backups and monitoring set up properly.

I also take over servers that 'just work' until they don't: undocumented setups, expiring certificates, full disks and missing backups.

### What I set up and manage

- **Cloud deployment on AWS**: Servers, S3 storage, environments and secure access.
- **Docker & deployments**: Containerised apps and repeatable, low-risk releases.
- **Shared & VPS hosting**: Hostinger (hPanel) and cPanel setup, migration and upkeep.
- **Domains, SSL & email**: DNS, HTTPS certificates and business email configuration.
- **Backups & monitoring**: Automated backups, uptime checks and alerts.
- **Performance & security**: Faster servers, fewer attack surfaces, safer updates.

### What's included

- Server or cloud setup
- Deployment of web app / API / database
- Domain, DNS and SSL
- Backups and restore test
- Monitoring and alerts
- Access and runbook documentation

### Technologies

AWS, S3, Docker, Hostinger, hPanel, cPanel, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB

### What affects the cost

- Number of apps, environments and databases
- AWS vs shared/VPS hosting
- Migration from an existing server
- Monitoring and on-call expectations
- Monthly maintenance vs one-time setup

### FAQ

**Can you move my website or app to AWS?**
Yes. I plan the migration, move the app and database, switch DNS with minimal downtime and keep the old server as a fallback until everything is verified.

**Do you offer monthly server maintenance?**
Yes. Updates, backups, monitoring, SSL renewals and fixes on a monthly basis.

**Should I use AWS or regular hosting?**
For a business website, good shared or VPS hosting is often enough and cheaper. AWS makes sense for APIs, apps with growing traffic and more control. I'll recommend based on your needs and budget.

## Blog

### Build a full-stack Dart app with Serverpod, Flutter, BLoC and clean architecture

URL: https://www.ansariatif.tech/blog/serverpod-flutter-bloc-clean-architecture · Published: 2026-10-16

A step-by-step Serverpod 4 tutorial: a Dart backend on PostgreSQL and a Flutter app built with BLoC and clean architecture, tested on both sides.

**Is Serverpod ready for production?**
Serverpod is open source and on its fourth major version, with migrations, logging, health checks and test tools built in. You can host it yourself on any server that runs Dart, or use the managed Serverpod Cloud. As with any framework, check that the features you need, such as your sign-in providers and file storage, are covered before you commit.

**Should I use Bloc or Cubit?**
A Cubit exposes methods (cubit.addTask('...')) instead of events. It's less code and fine for simple screens. Use a Bloc when you want every user action recorded as an event, or need event transformers such as debounce or droppable(). The domain and data layers in this tutorial work unchanged with either.

**Can I use Riverpod or Provider instead of BLoC?**
Yes. Only the presentation layer changes: the use cases, repository and data source stay exactly as they are. That's the point of keeping the layers separate.
